card.text: Moon that shares its orbit with Epimetheus, trading places with it.

introduction.text: Janus is probably a rubble pile held together by gravity. Audouin Dollfus first saw it in 1966.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain hidden in shadow is left empty.

filter-color.title: Cassini false color
filter-color.summary: Measured filter bands in false color, not human-visible color. Photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below an 89.2 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
